blocks.text: MEGASPEED. DATA CENTRES IN SINGAPORE. WASHINGTON SUSPECTS ITS CEO OF SPYING FOR BEIJING.
THE UNITED STATES IS WORRIED, IT'S TRUE. BUT HERE, EVERYONE KNOWS THE LINES BETWEEN TECHNOLOGY, FINANCE AND POWER ARE GETTING BLURRIER AND BLURRIER.
YOUR FRIEND APPROACHED ME THE WAY YOU APPROACH A CHIP TYCOON. A CONTACT WHO DOESN'T EXIST, A PARROT, AND HERE I AM.
THEN YOU HAVE ALREADY UNDERSTOOD THE ESSENTIAL. THE REST IS PATIENCE.
AND HONG KONG IS STILL THE BEST PLACE TO WATCH WHERE HISTORY IS GOING.
NETWORKS CHANGE, AND SO DO THE TOOLS. BUT FROM ONE WAR TO THE NEXT, THE SAME GAME ALWAYS RETURNS: CONTROL INFORMATION TO STEER THE WORLD.
